The paper (lines 2054, 2187-2193) omits the top position j_{f-1} so the segments stay disjoint, then does it at the end with a two-bit elementary stream operation costing O(V). When f=1, S_0 and T_0 are identities. The page never says T_0 acts only at j_0..j_{f-2}, or how the last bit is handled.
